description: DSv4-Flash on the pulsar ds4 engine, serveable TODAY (kernel inventory as of 2026-09, pulsar dev): routed-expert tensors run on the IQ2_XXS (k-major MMQ) / Q2_K paths or the checkpoint-native MXFP4 grid; attention, shared-expert and dense tensors run ONLY on the FP8 tensor-core path (MXFP8_E4M3 group-32 re-encode); the token embedding and the output head are plain bf16 (a deliberate fidelity choice). No IQ2_XS / IQ2_S / Q3_K expert kernels exist, and non-expert projections have no IQ/k-quant path at all.

export_lane.exporter: pulsar gguf-tools/deepseek4-quantize (out of tree; per-tensor --format-map JSON)
export_lane.detail: pulsar's quantizer writes exactly the formats its engine has kernels for; the declaration module mirrors its format-map vocabulary

format_rules.detail: routed-expert tensors: engine kernels exist only for IQ2_XXS, Q2_K, and the checkpoint-native MXFP4 grid (no IQ2_XS/IQ2_S/Q3_K expert kernels)
token embedding and output head are shipped as plain bf16 (source-exact); the engine has no quantized path for them
attention / shared-expert / dense projections are served only on the FP8 tensor-core path (MXFP8_E4M3 group-32); no IQ/k-quant kernels exist for them

shape_rules.detail: GGUF k-quants and 256-superblock IQ types pack 256-element superblocks along the input dim
OCP MX formats scale 32-element groups (E8M0 per-group scale) along the input dim
